text:
Maya: hey — first day! trying to run the quickstart but my pods aren't showing up in staging. `kubectl get pods` returns nothing.
Priya: welcome 🎉 which context are you on? run `kubectl config current-context`
Maya: it says `dev-sandbox` but the quickstart guide mentions `redwood-staging`. i tried `kubectl config use-context redwood-staging` but still empty namespace.
Priya: ah ok — after switching context also check `kubectl config view --minify --flatten` to confirm current cluster + user. also check your namespace: `kubectl config view --minify --output 'jsonpath={..namespace}'`
Maya: result is blank. i think i'm in the default ns. do i need a namespace created for my user?
Sam: quick answer: yes we give new hires a personal namespace `maya-dev` (or your-username-dev). i can create it and bind developer role.
Maya: that would be amazing, thanks Sam :pray:
Olivia: FYI devex doc has a step under "Namespaces & RBAC" — you can also set the current namespace: `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=maya-dev` once it's created.
Sam: creating now. running: `kubectl create namespace maya-dev` then `kubectl create rolebinding maya-dev-edit --clusterrole=edit --serviceaccount=redwood:default -n maya-dev` — wait, we'll use a user binding instead.
Sam: done — namespace `maya-dev` created and you have edit role. try `kubectl get pods -n maya-dev` and `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=maya-dev`
Maya: set the namespace, can see my deployment now. thanks! one more q: sometimes i need to run commands against prod for debugging — what's the approved flow for escalation?
Priya: prod access is gated. file a request in #eng-sre with justification + link to runbook. we prefer ephemeral kubeconfig via `kubectl debug` role or impersonation. don't ever store prod kubeconfig locally.
Maya: noted. where's the runbook?
Priya: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/kubernetes (link) — it's the onboarding page with the RBAC matrix.
Maya: perfect, thanks team :smile:
deploy-bot: scheduled job `onboard-check` succeeded for user maya (namespace maya-dev) :white_check_mark:
Olivia: tagging @sam — thanks for the assist.
Sam: np, ping me if you need serviceaccount tokens or port-forwarding set up.
Maya: will do, really appreciate the quick help!
